lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five vertical rows with relatively uniform spacing between local maxima within each column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance blobs are centered within vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity, creating a grid-like intersection where the vertical stripes act as the primary axes for the circular nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from light top-facing pixels to darker shadowed pixels immediately beneath the ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a cluster of small, darker fish (likely remoras) visible near the ventral side of the pectoral fin attachment; complex vermiculated pattern (mixed lines and spots) on the anterior dorsal head region.
